notes.title: 👻🎃 Spooktacular Halloween Update! 🎃👻
notes.notes:
It's the night when ghosts come alive and freely roam among the living, and no one's here to stop them. Witches have taken advantage of the situation, disappearing to their own wicked soiree while leaving the ghosts in charge of the students. And, these mischievous apparitions are absolutely thrilled to take charge and show off their spectral prowess.

👀 Keep an eye out for eerie surprises and supernatural shenanigans as our ghostly minions and the restless spirits of the school take center stage. 🎉👻

🕸️🕷️ But beware! In this Halloween event, tricks and treats go hand in hand. Explore the spooky surprises, join the ghostly festivities, and uncover the secrets hidden in the shadows of the night. It's a Halloween like no other, and it's all happening right here at Blackberry the Witch: Journey! 🕷️🕸️

Don't miss out on the spine-chilling fun. Join us for the Halloween event of a lifetime, where ghosts, witches, and students collide in a night of enchanting chaos!

notes.title: Exciting News: Blackberry the Witch: Journey Game Release!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the long-awaited release of our new game, "Blackberry the Witch: Journey"! Get ready to embark on a captivating magical adventure like never before!

In "Blackberry the Witch: Journey," you will immerse yourself in an enchanting world of magic, riddles, and dangers. Take on the role of a young witch named Blackberry and set off on an incredible journey through mystical lands. Prepare to face new challenges, unravel intricate puzzles, encounter marvelous creatures, and forge fateful connections!

Immerse yourself in a lovingly crafted world where attention to detail has created a truly magical atmosphere. Stunning locations, mesmerizing animations, and a magical soundtrack will transport you to the fantastical world of Primis. Explore a multitude of levels, battle mighty foes, and solve puzzles to overcome obstacles.

After years of dedicated development, we are delighted to share the game with you. "Blackberry the Witch: Journey" is now available for purchase and download! We can't wait for you to embark on this thrilling adventure!

Stay tuned for updates as we have new localizations and surprises in store for Steam. In the future, we plan to expand to mobile platforms as well.

Thank you for your support throughout the game's development. Join us to delve into a world of magic and incredible discoveries with Blackberry by your side!

With love and excitement,
The Creepybox Games Team ːcozyroeː

notes.title: The game release is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello, adventure!

We have exciting news for you! We are thrilled to announce the upcoming release of our first game, "Blackberry the Witch: Journey"!

"Blackberry the Witch: Journey" is an immersive adventure game that will take you into a world of magic, riddles, and dangers. You will assume the role of a young witch named Blackberry and embark on an incredible journey through magical lands. Prepare yourself for new challenges, puzzles, encounters with amazing creatures, and fateful acquaintances!

We have paid special attention to detail in the game to create a magical atmosphere and provide you with unforgettable experiences. Vibrant locations, enchanting animations, and a delightful soundtrack await you, immersing you in a new fantastical world. You will explore numerous levels, solve puzzles, battle mighty enemies, and unlock new spells to overcome obstacles.

We have dedicated several years of hard work to "Blackberry the Witch: Journey," and we can't wait to share this game with you. It will be available on the Steam platform starting July 14th, 2023!

Stay tuned for updates to learn more about patches, our new projects, and other exciting details.

Thank you for your support! We eagerly await the moment when we can take you on a captivating journey into the world of magic alongside Blackberry!

With love, your Creepybox Games ːcozyroeː
